speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. When did you deliver, and how high has your fever been? I also need to know if you are experiencing any pain or tenderness in your abdomen.

text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

text: Do you have any foul-smelling or unusual vaginal discharge, and are you experiencing pain or burning when you urinate? I would also like to know if you have had any difficulty passing urine or if you feel like your bladder is not fully emptying.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal ultrasound and urine results, your symptoms of fever and uterine tenderness after prolonged labor strongly point to postpartum endometritis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Endometritis
